treeHash_algorithm: sha256 over the sorted list of unique file sha256 values, joined with newline, with one trailing newline
notes: Vendor skills are instruction-only markdown (no scripts, no binaries).
The vendor package is never a runtime dependency and is never installed on client boxes or fleet-wide.
Only vendor_skill_probe.sh installs it, into a disposable temp HOME, to detect upstream drift.
State on mismatch is UNKNOWN-DRIFT until a human re-reviews and re-approves; see references/integration-policy.md.
